name: SideNav
purpose: The product's primary navigation in the left column of AppShell. Not for sections within a page; that is TabNav.
description: Groups of links with optional headings and icons. One item is active and carries aria-current="page". Item height follows the density mode. AppShell gives it a full-height, independently scrolling column on surface layer-1.

icon.description: On SideNav.Item: a decorative Icon before the label.

asChild.description: On SideNav.Item: render a router Link instead of an anchor.

keyboard: Tab: move between items (each is a link)
a11y.name: The landmark takes its name from aria-label; each group list from its visible title (aria-labelledby); each item from its text. Group titles are not headings, so they do not interrupt the page outline.
notes: The active item has aria-current="page" and a tinted background plus accent text, so selection is not shown by colour of one property alone.
Icons are decorative; the label always names the item.

motion.description: Item background and text colour ease on hover.

rules: Exactly one item is active, and it matches the current route.
Group related destinations under a short heading; keep fewer than ten items per group.
With a router, pass the Link through asChild so client-side navigation keeps working.
Place SideNav in AppShell's sideNav slot; it does not set its own width or background.
dos: Use icons for every item in a group or for none of them.
donts: Do not put actions (buttons) in SideNav; it is for navigation only.
